answer: The EDPB Opinion 28-2024 describes the relationship between AI models and AI systems in the AI Act by stating that AI models are essential components of AI systems but do not constitute AI systems on their own. AI models require additional components, such as a user interface, to become AI systems. Essentially, AI models are integrated into AI systems, which combine the model with the necessary components to deploy it effectively. The Opinion emphasizes that an AI system relies on an AI model to perform its intended objectives within a larger framework.
